trigger_condition: submit_or_cancel returns MARKET_NOT_READY or Service is not ready
action: limited_retry_then_reconcile
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: platform_service_state,retry_trace,order_query_after_retry。
close_condition: platform accepts query and no unknown submit outcomes remain

trigger_condition: submit request timeout or ambiguous transport failure after order creation attempt
action: query_order_trades_user_channel_before_resubmit
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: unknown_submit_outcome,order_query,user_channel_events。
close_condition: outcome classified as rejected, accepted, filled, cancelled, or expired

trigger_condition: post order response lacks nonempty platform order id or contains unknown/error text
action: reject accepted path and block ledger reservation
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: raw_submit_response,accepted_classifier_trace。
close_condition: classifier has valid id, status, scope, and no reject error

trigger_condition: SELL rejected for balance/allowance after recent fill or local ledger inventory
action: record maturity probe and avoid overwriting local ledger
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: sell_reject_raw,maturity_probe,ledger_snapshot。
close_condition: sellable balance cleanly accepts or probe window expires with audit classification

trigger_condition: chain allowance differs from CLOB balance allowance or signature_type/funder is missing
action: block trading until wallet source map and CLOB balance allowance pass
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: wallet_source_map,balance_allowance_preflight。
close_condition: EOA/proxy/deposit wallet/funder/signature_type all match configured mode

trigger_condition: tick_size_change event or quote rejected by tick/min/max validator
action: refresh market metadata and requantize action
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: tick_size_event,market_metadata_snapshot,quantizer_trace。
close_condition: fresh metadata snapshot and action passes quantizer

trigger_condition: order_version_mismatch or SDK signing smoke fails
action: upgrade SDK/signing path within SDK-first boundary
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: sdk_version_smoke,changelog_refresh。
close_condition: official SDK smoke passes for configured signature mode

trigger_condition: high-risk changelog migration or startup after platform order migration
action: run open-order inventory audit before new orders
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: startup_open_order_audit,changelog_breaking_change_flag。
close_condition: open orders reconciled and stale orders cancelled or marked absent

trigger_condition: market fee/rebate/reward source missing or older than online_rule_version
action: refresh current market fee/rebate/reward snapshot
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: current_market_info_snapshot,fee_rebate_reward_breakdown。
close_condition: fee_rate_bps, maker_rebate, reward fields have current source URL and timestamp

trigger_condition: tail-window action age plus taker delay exceeds strategy cutoff
action: expire action and record skipped opportunity
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: latency_stage_trace,tail_window_cutoff_case。
close_condition: action age within TTL and latency budget

trigger_condition: missing snapshot, stale heartbeat, stale book age, or hash discontinuity
action: block quote and refresh via WSS/REST fallback
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: wss_freshness_report,book_snapshot_gate。
close_condition: fresh snapshot, acceptable age, hash recorded

trigger_condition: late user-channel or synthetic event references already covered order/fill
action: apply alias or covered-by-synthetic rule without duplicate ledger entry
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: normalized_order_events,alias_resolution_case。
close_condition: raw event digest linked to normalized fact

trigger_condition: endpoint bucket near limit, 429, or batch cancel size above limit
action: jitter_backoff_or_batch_split
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: rate_limit_bucket_trace,cancel_batch_plan。
close_condition: bucket capacity available and pending batch sizes legal

trigger_condition: reward/rebate eligibility fields missing or quote outside scoring constraints
action: separate reward accounting from core PnL and mark ineligible quotes
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: reward_eligibility_report,fee_rebate_reward_breakdown。
close_condition: reward eligibility and accounting route classified

trigger_condition: training/report mixes maker, tail-snipe, and directional labels or PnL
action: split strategy family and block leaderboard entry
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: strategy_family_registry,label_source_audit。
close_condition: each sample has one strategy_family and compatible label source

trigger_condition: maker baseline lacks post-only, inventory skew, merge/redeem boundary, or panic controls
action: block maker promotion until risk controls are specified
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: rule_maker_baseline_spec,inventory_risk_cases。
close_condition: required maker controls present and tested

trigger_condition: single API or snapshot used as global truth for order, position, and ledger
action: split offchain_order_state, onchain_position_state, data_api_projection, local_ledger
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: state_authority_matrix,reconciliation_report。
close_condition: all state writes declare authority layer and timestamp

trigger_condition: candidate market lacks token ids, active state, expiry, tick/min size, or fee snapshot
action: block trading and refresh Gamma/CLOB market info
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: market_discovery_gate_report,current_market_info_snapshot。
close_condition: candidate passes all MarketDiscoveryGate required fields

trigger_condition: state transition between markets without clearing per-market buffers or auditing old orders
action: cancel/audit old market, clear buffers, require snapshot and warmup
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: market_switch_gate_report,per_market_state_audit。
close_condition: new market has fresh snapshot and seq_len warmup

trigger_condition: prefetched market context is referenced by submit path before switch gate
action: separate prefetched and active contexts
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: prefetch_context_audit,market_switch_gate_report。
close_condition: submit path references only active_market_context

trigger_condition: model bundle loaded without sha/schema/session/warmup verification
action: block active model and keep shadow/offline
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: model_bundle_preflight_report,inference_warmup_metrics。
close_condition: bundle passes hash, schema, ORT session options, and warmup latency gates

trigger_condition: active model session replaced in place or shadow model lacks validation
action: use ModelRegistry active/shadow/retired and drain before activation
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: model_registry_state,shadow_model_comparison。
close_condition: shadow passes schema, latency, calibration, and rollback metadata

trigger_condition: ORT intra/inter op threads exceed host tier limit or live host runs build/train
action: enforce HardwareTierGate and ORT thread caps
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: hardware_tier_gate_report,ort_thread_profile。
close_condition: workload and ORT threads comply with host_class

trigger_condition: thread spinning enabled without CPU/event-loop/feed-age telemetry
action: record spin profile or disable spinning on live host
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: ort_spin_profile,resource_watermark_gate_report。
close_condition: spinning setting has p95/p99, CPU, and feed-age evidence

trigger_condition: maker training uses direction-only label or claims true FIFO queue position from aggregated WSS
action: require queue_proxy/fill_hazard and adverse-selection labels
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: execution_feedback_labels,fill_hazard_features。
close_condition: labels include fill/no-fill, post-fill return, size-ahead estimate, censoring reason

trigger_condition: traditional maker formula promoted without Polymarket calibration
action: treat as baseline and require market artifact calibration
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: rule_maker_baseline_spec,calibration_report。
close_condition: binary payoff, expiry, fee/rebate, and position cap included

trigger_condition: book-derived feature lacks snapshot/hash/age/own-order/censoring fields
action: block label/training row until book artifact contract is complete
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: book_artifact_contract,queue_proxy_features。
close_condition: required book and censoring fields present

trigger_condition: leaderboard entry lacks full trial ledger, split_id, cost assumptions, or final holdout
action: block leaderboard/promotion
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: experiment_trial_ledger,leaderboard_gate_report。
close_condition: trial_count, split_id, feature_version, online_rule_version, cost basis, final holdout all present

trigger_condition: feedback label lacks decision context, maturity time, authority source, or no-quote opportunity samples
action: block training ingestion
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: execution_feedback_labels,label_quality_report。
close_condition: label row passes schema and label maturity gate

trigger_condition: discovery relies only on timestamp slug without active/keyset fallback or clock check
action: run candidate slug plus active/keyset scan and NTP drift check
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: market_discovery_gate_report,discovery_miss_rate。
close_condition: dual-path discovery and clock checks pass

trigger_condition: memory growth interpreted without cgroup stat/events/PSI split
action: classify anon/file/slab and memory.events before intervention
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: resource_watermark_gate_report,cgroup_samples。
close_condition: pressure state classified as clean, warning, no-submit, or fail-closed

trigger_condition: disk free below threshold, journal near cap, or manifest atomic write fails
action: rotate/compress logs, block submit, move to cancel-only if severe
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: resource_watermark_gate_report,disk_usage_samples。
close_condition: disk/journal/artifact backlog below threshold and manifest write passes

trigger_condition: stage latency or action age exceeds strategy TTL
action: expire action and record skipped opportunity
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: latency_stage_trace,action_ttl_gate_report。
close_condition: all stage latency within TTL

trigger_condition: external repo requires install/run or tries to access env/wallet/api key
action: block install/run and require isolated review environment
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: supply_chain_gate_report,external_repo_inventory。
close_condition: pinned commit, lockfile hash, no secrets, and network egress mode verified

trigger_condition: paper/live/training report lacks online_rule_version or docs last_checked_date
action: refresh official docs/changelog and bind report to rule version
reproduction_method: 按 trigger_condition 构造复现或 replay case，并检查 artifacts: online_rule_version,changelog_refresh_report。
close_condition: report references current online_rule_version and source snapshot
